title: NCUC Docket W-1300, SUB 71 — Order Approving Tariff Revision
text:
STATE OF NORTH CAROLINA 
UTILITIES COMMISSION 
RALEIGH 

DOCKET NO. W-1300, SUB 71 

BEFORE THE NORTH CAROLINA UTILITIES COMMISSION 

In the Matter of 
Application by Old North State Water 
Company, LLC, 4700 Homewood Court, 
Suite 108, Raleigh, North Carolina 27609, 
for Authority to Amend its Tariff to Increase 
Wastewater Connection Fees in its 
Briar Chapel Subdivision Service Area in 
Chatham County, North Carolina 
) 
) 
) 
) 
) 
) 
) 

ORDER APPROVING 
TARIFF REVISION 

BY THE COMMISSION: On March 8, 2021, Old North State Water Company, LLC, 
(ONSWC) filed a petition with the Commission seeking to amend its tariff for the purpose 
of increasing its wastewater connection fee for its Briar Chapel subdivision service area 
in Chatham County, North Carolina. 
ONSWC’s current wastewater connection fee is $1,500 per residential equivalent 
unit (REU). ONSWC’s proposed wastewater connection fee is $4,000 per REU. 
ONSWC’s current wastewater connection fee was approved in Docket Nos. W-1300, 
Sub 9 and W-1230, Sub 1, in the Commission’s Recommended Order Approving 
Transfer, Granting Franchise, Approving Rates, and Requiring Customer Notice dated 
April 20, 20151. 
The Briar Chapel subdivision currently has 2,119 residential customers and 
21 commercial customers. For the full build-out of the Briar Chapel subdivision, there will 
be approximately 414 additional commercial customers and 180 new residential 
customers. 
ONSWC is currently increasing the capacity of the existing Briar Chapel 
wastewater treatment plant from 250,000 gallons per day (GPD) to 500,000 GPD. The 
expansion of the plant is anticipated to be completed in December 2021. The primary 
reason for the increased wastewater connection fee is to aid in recovery of the cost of the 
facility expansion and to provide service for new development. 
On March 19, 2021, the Briar Chapel customer group StopChathamNorth, 
consisting of a large number of current Briar Chapel residential customers, filed an email 
with the Commission in support of ONSWC’s proposed $4,000 per REU connection fee. 

1 Also on April 20, 2015, in Docket Nos. W-1300, Sub 9 and W-1230, Sub 1, the Commission issued 
an Order Allowing Recommended Order to Become Effective and Final. The April 20, 2015 Recommended 
Order approved the transfer of the wastewater utility assets and the franchise to provide wastewater service 
in the Briar Chapel Subdivision (including the Herndon Woods Subdivision) in Chatham County, North 
Carolina, from Briar Chapel Utilities, LLC, to ONSWC and continued the $1,500 per REU wastewater 
connection fee established for Briar Chapel Utilities, LLC, in Docket No. W-1230, Sub 0, per Commission 
Order issued on December 8, 2009. 

2 

StopChathamNorth stated that the new development driving the wastewater treatment 
plant expansion should help offset the capital costs of this upgrade with an increase in 
the connection fees to $4,000 per REU. 
The Public Staff – North Carolina Utilities Commission (Public Staff) presented this 
matter at the Commission’s Staff Conference on April 19, 2021, and recommends 
approval of the connection fee increase from $1,500 to $4,000 per REU. 
Based upon the foregoing and the recommendation of the Public Staff, the 
Commission concludes that ONSWC should be allowed to increase its wastewater 
connection fee from $1,500 to $4,000 per REU for its Briar Chapel service area. 
IT IS, THEREFORE, ORDERED as follows: 
1. 
That Old North State Water Company, LLC, is granted a tariff revision to 
increase its wastewater connection fee from $1,500 to $4,000 per REU in the Briar Chapel 
service area; and 
2. 
That the Schedule of Rates, attached hereto, as Appendix A is approved 
and deemed filed with the Commission pursuant to N.C. Gen. Stat. § 62-138. 
ISSUED BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION. 
This the 19th day of April, 2021. 

NORTH CAROLINA UTILITIES COMMISSION 

A. Shonta Dunston, Deputy Clerk
